t: Transected Achilles tendon heals faster with BPC-157, rats (2003)
who: Rats with a cut Achilles tendon
f: BPC-157 rats healed with stronger tendons, better walking scores and more collagen, and the gap closed; untreated rats healed poorly.

t: Transected quadriceps muscle heals with BPC-157, rats (2006)
who: Rats with a fully cut thigh muscle
f: Daily BPC-157 reconnected the cut muscle, restored strength and walking over 72 days and limited wasting.

t: BPC-157 raises VEGF and new vessels in muscle and tendon healing, rats (2009)

t: BPC-157 heals cysteamine colitis and colon anastomosis, rats (2013)

t: BPC-157 speeds sciatic nerve healing after cut, rats (2009)

t: Retatrutide phase 2a trial in fatty liver disease (2024)
who: 98 adults with obesity and fatty liver, 48 weeks
f: Liver fat fell about 81–82% at the 8 and 12 mg doses by week 24; 79–86% of those people reached normal liver fat, none on placebo.

t: TRIUMPH-1: retatrutide in obesity or overweight

f: Registry record only. Results are not posted here yet; the 28.3% weight loss figure comes from a company press release.

t: Retatrutide delays stomach emptying, phase 1b (2023)

t: TRIUMPH-4: retatrutide in obesity with knee osteoarthritis

t: Tirzepatide vs semaglutide on insulin release and sensitivity (2022)

t: Tirzepatide briefly delays stomach emptying (2020)

t: Tirzepatide acts on fat cells through the GIP receptor (2024)

t: SURMOUNT-OSA: tirzepatide for sleep apnoea and obesity (2024)

t: Food craving brain signal quiets in one person on tirzepatide (2025)

t: SELECT: semaglutide and heart events in obesity (2023)

t: FLOW: semaglutide and kidney disease in type 2 diabetes (2024)

t: Intranasal glutathione in Parkinson's, phase 2b (2017)
